reasoning: The icon is a generic 2x2 grid of squares primarily used as UI chrome for switching to grid/tile view or opening an app launcher. Because it represents an abstract layout toggle rather than a concrete real-world object, it rarely cues a specific task at a glance and is easily confused with generic menu icons.
